text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of an admissions trial event for prospective young students.
Yaeno Muteki was tasked with guiding a group of kids, but...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! You can see the whole track from here!
Look, people are running!!
One, two, threeâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, aren't you a playful one♪
Careful now, leaning out too far is dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If anyone wants a better view from up high, I'll give you a piggyback ride! Raise your hands if you want up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Mmmm!
I can't read it... I can't grasp it! The distance is...!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I simply do not understand! How to maintain a proper distance with children!
Compared to those two, I am far too inexperienced... A-And besides—"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
If Mi-chan gets a piggyback ride,
I wonder if I can see all the way to my house~?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Nope! I'm not getting a piggyback ride,
I'm riding on their shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Guh... I want to protect them...! But overprotecting
them will interfere with the orientation...
and hinder their independence...!
choice_data_list: Do you have any experience dealing with kids at the dojo?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Come to think of it, I used to
train my little brother a lot.
If I go with that approach...!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Squad Yaeno, fall in!!
Bow before the gods... no, the Three Goddesses!
Bow before the shihan... no, before me!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hey!! Bow properly!!
Put your spirit into it, your spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: Th-This lady... is kinda scary...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
D-Drat...! Thinking of him as a younger brother
makes my true self slip out...!
This will have the opposite effect...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... There is no need to push yourself too hard.
If you simply interact with the children as your usual self,
they will surely accept you, Yaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san... But I lack confidence.
I fear my uncouth nature will only frighten
the children, just as it did just now――"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Huuuh? Shi-chan's
not here? Where are you—!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, one child from Yaeno Muteki's group
is missing. They were definitely here a moment ago...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah! Over there!

text_block_list.name: Curious Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Wow.
Everyone is so fast...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over... captivated by the sight of the Umamusume
running, a child was wandering right onto the track!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Oh no! What if I crash into a running Umamusume?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(If I rush to help right now... will I make it in time!?
Ah, Yaeno Muteki, you fool!!
If only you had been paying attention... ugh...!!)
(—Do not waver!! Yaeno!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
“—No matter how formidable the foe, no matter how dire the straits,
to merely retreat is folly, and to cringe is cowardice.
A path will never open that way.”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Should doubt arise in your heart, there is only one answer.
Identify the one path you can take with no regrets, and...
do what must be done!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(—That's it! Right now, there is only one thing
I must pour my heart and soul into achieving—)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“...... Huh!?
W-What on earth was I... doing?”

text_block_list.name: Curious Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Big sis... you're amazing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yaeno-san!?
What was that speed just now!?
You totally took me by surprise!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Just when I thought she dove in, in the blink of an eye she scooped that girl up and carried her off the track...!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, that was amazing!!
You were super cool!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“...... I see.
Did I... manage to accomplish what I set out to do?”
choice_data_list: You let your running do the talking!
You let your running speak for itself!
The teachings of the Kongou Yaegaki style are really paying off, huh.
The teachings of the Kongou Yaegaki style are really paying off, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“...... I see.
Did I... manage to accomplish what I set out to do?”
choice_data_list: You let your running do the talking!
You let your running speak for itself!
The teachings of the Kongou Yaegaki style are really paying off, huh.
The teachings of the Kongou Yaegaki style are really paying off, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I remembered my grandfather's words.
The mindset of a Yaegaki warrior."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"'Stand tall and proud before the world as a "protector".
Face all challenges without hesitation, remain silent,
and carry through your own "righteousness" to the end'..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The teachings instilled in my mind and body are what drove me forward.
That is... what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she suffered a momentary setback, Yaeno Muteki recovered through her own strength and gained even more confidence.
The orientation ended in a complete success.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Kongo Yaegaki-ryu!?
If I learn that, will I become just like you, Big Sis!? I wanna do it, I wanna do it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm... But still, the training of the
Kongo Yaegaki Style is exceedingly rigorous...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that case... how about just doing it as a casual trial?
Everyone's having so much fun, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san... Understood.
Now... this time for sure, everyone fall in!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Yaeno Muteki served as the master for the children, completely winning their respect as the orientation wrapped up.
